en.headline: High-speed rail cross-border trips top 20 million this year, 11 days earlier than 2025
en.dek: Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong Express Rail Link carried 20.054 million passengers as of 10 August, with weekend daily averages 25 per cent higher than weekdays.
body: Cross-border passenger trips on the Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong high-speed rail reached 20.054 million as of 10 August, 11 days earlier than the same milestone last year, according to figures reported by railway authorities.

Mainland-to-Hong Kong journeys accounted for 10.327 million and Hong Kong-to-mainland trips 9.727 million. Weekend traffic averaged 105,000 passengers a day, about 25 per cent higher than weekdays. The single-day record of 149,000 was set on 4 April.

During the summer holiday period from 1 July to 10 August the line carried 3.817 million passengers, averaging 93,000 a day. On 8 August, driven by cross-border concerts and events, daily volume hit 136,000. The growth reflects deeper Greater Bay Area integration and rising leisure travel.

zh.headline: 廣深港高鐵跨境客流今年提前11天破2000萬人次
zh.dek: 截至8月10日累計運送旅客2005.4萬人次，周末日均較平日高約25%，暑運期間受演唱會等活動帶動再創新高。
body: 廣深港高鐵跨境客流持續攀升，截至8月10日累計運送旅客達2005.4萬人次，較去年提前11天突破2000萬人次。
內地前往香港1032.7萬人次，香港前往內地972.7萬人次。周末日均客流約10.5萬人次，較平日高約25%。4月4日創下單日14.9萬人次歷史高位。
暑假期間（7月1日至8月10日）累計運送381.7萬人次，日均約9.3萬人次。8月8日受深港兩地演唱會及活動帶動，當日客流達13.6萬人次。客流增長反映大灣區融合加深及休閒出行需求上升。
